title: Sam single-week replay on Alpaca bars -- PRE-REGISTRATION (written and committed BEFORE any test-week bar was retrieved)
label: NOT BLIND -- see limitation
limitation: No historical week can be established as unseen for Sam. Every date from 2007-02-07 through 2026-09-30 has been used for his training (development lane 2007-02-07..2018-12-31), evaluation (qualification 2019-01-01..2022-12-31 incl. d1_qualification_generalization; championship holdout 2023-2025; final-reserve-period replays 2026-01-01..2026-08-25) or selection (the 2025-01-01..2026-09-30 ranking replays that picked him). Alpaca daily history begins around 2016, so older never-evaluated data (pre-2007) is unavailable from Alpaca. The only post-selection dates are 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02.

week_selection.rule: Among complete Mon-Fri calendar weeks whose five dates are all regular exchange sessions and that end on or before the last completed session (2026-10-02), choose the week with the MOST sessions strictly after 2026-09-30 (last date used by any recorded selection/evaluation of Sam); ties -> most recent. Fixed before any bar for the candidate week was retrieved.
week_selection.performance_inspected_before_freeze: none (no prices or returns for these dates were read by the operator before this commit; the EC2 replay files that include 09-28..09-30 inside 15/21-month aggregates were not opened for those days)
week_selection.stop_rule: If the Alpaca calendar does not show exactly these five regular sessions, stop and report; do not pick another week.

strategy.step_anchor: step 0 = first session of the test week (same convention as every earlier replay); so exactly one decision (Mon 2026-09-28 close), filled at Tue open
strategy.history: adjusted closes up to and including the decision session; warm-up (>=123 sessions, fetched from 2026-03-01) strictly precedes the week

pilot_overlay.how: weights scaled so gross <= ceiling (same scaling as the accepted replay harness 18% overlay arm); Sam's native 23% cap is otherwise untouched

halt.mechanism: s6a_final.DRAWDOWN_HALT set to 0.08 inside the harness process only (restored after); latch + liquidate-to-cash on the account's close-mark drawdown
halt.liquidation: orders sized by held share quantity (execution.compute_orders with an empty target) -- needs no price

order_caps.enforcement: asserted/reported by the harness; the simulated engine has no ledger

pilot_assumptions_used_for_testing_only.cash_reserve_note: non-binding at an 18% gross ceiling; not separately simulated

expiry.replay_clock_rule: any simulated session on/after the expiry is BLOCKED and reported, never bypassed

not_modelled: broker timeouts / delayed visibility (no broker in a replay)

execution_assumptions.decision_time: session close; may use only bars dated <= the decision session
execution_assumptions.fill: next session's RAW OPEN (IEX feed), never the decision bar
execution_assumptions.costs_note: explicit simulated assumptions (accepted evaluator model); bars do not prove actual execution, queue priority, partial fills or opening-auction prices
execution_assumptions.marks: raw close each session; cash dividends not credited (live bars carry none)
execution_assumptions.one_run: a single deterministic pass; the two cost cases are computed together and both reported; no parameter, genome, week or code change after seeing results

benchmarks.passive_same_week: equal-weight 8 ETFs totalling 18% gross, decided at step 0, filled at Tue open, same costs and marks

data_spec.timezone: bar timestamps are UTC at ET midnight (04:00Z EDT); the bar date is the ET calendar date
data_spec.retrieval: read-only GETs via the existing runtime_credential_loader on the research instance over SSM; nothing written to the instance, no orders
data_spec.adjustment_caveat: adjusted values are as of retrieval (2026-10-04); a corporate action between 2026-10-02 and retrieval would back-adjust the history (none expected; disclosed)
data_spec.gap_rule: any missing symbol/session bar inside the week, or <123 warm-up sessions, stops the replay at that point and is reported as a data failure (no interpolation)

metrics: strategy result separated from execution/data limitations
power_disclosure: One rebalance decision and four holding days: a single week cannot support any claim of edge; it is a plumbing/behaviour check.
engine_identical_to_candidate_commit: git diff e81ceab -- shadow_compare.py lineage_d.py session_calendar.py scripts/{s6a_runtime,s6a_final,execution,risk}.py is empty
harness_validation_done_before_freeze: 7 offline tests on OLD data only: Sam overlay arm equals replay_harness.simulate exactly at 5 and 10 bps (end equity, orders, fills, turnover, cost); passive and cash controls equal the accepted arms; 8% halt liquidates by quantity on a synthetic crash; ceiling and order caps respected; globals restored.
